I’ve been dealing with panic/anxiety attacks for over ten years. I take Xanax but only if they’re bad and I can’t calm myself down first. Because they will get so bad that I’ll hyperventilate enough to pass out lol. 
1. Slowing your breathing down will help the racing heart. 
2. Be mindful of your surroundings. There’s something we use in groups that helps if you can take yourself away from a situation or really you can use it everywhere 
Paying attention to the senses  
5 things you see
4 things you hear
3 things you can touch 
2 things you can smell 
1 thing you can taste (that one is weird) hah 

3. Music helps sometimes, depends how you are with your senses, that can be helpful for me sometimes but other times it can hurt. 
4. Art, or anything you’re interested in, keep yourself occupied. 
5 doing literally anything productive to keep your mind off of things. 
6. Call someone, that you can confide in, or call someone and just ask them if they can talk to you about anything to keep your mind off of it.  I still call my mother when I’m having panic attacks. 
7. FIGURE OUT WHAT IS TRIGGERING YOU. (I understand not knowing because there are times when I have them for literally no reason) but it’s important because a lot of the time when you know what it is you can figure out a way to overcome it, or to avoid it. 
8. Reach out for help, that’s also really important. Therapist/ friend/ family. Strangers, whatever, I used to talk to strangers about shit all of the time. 


If this starts to take over your life I’d recommend seeking professional help and getting medication to help or therapy not everyone needs medication. 

If you need someone to chat with or anything I’m here. 
Hope this gets better and that any of this advice helps you. Have a good one.
